content:
Rodney’s argument focuses on European capitalist exploitation draining Africa’s wealth and impeding its development.  
In the period 1450–1750, the transatlantic slave trade expanded dramatically, forcibly removing millions of Africans to the New World, which fits his description of wealth draining and exploitation.  
Colonization of Africa’s interior (A) largely occurred after 1750, especially in the 19th century.  
Christianity’s spread (C) and New World crop imports (D) were part of the Columbian Exchange but not the central exploitation Rodney emphasizes.  

Final answer: (B)
